description: This file contains the implementation of the TextGetter class, which iterates through content streams of PDF files to extract and analyze text elements for inspection, including position, encoding, and related state information.

classes.name: TextGetter
classes.description: A class that derives from ObjectGetterBase, designed to iterate over PDF content streams and extract text elements along with positional and encoding information.

methods.name: IdentifyingElementCheck
methods.description: Checks if a given element corresponds to the 'Tj' operator, indicating a text element in a PDF content stream.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves the current text object from the content stream, including sequence, position, and encoding details.

methods.name: GetCurrentCoordinates
methods.description: Calculates the current X and Y positions within the content stream based on 'Td' operators and offsets.

methods.name: GetCurrentOffset
methods.description: Retrieves X and Y offsets from the content stream, based on preceding 'Td' operators.

methods.name: MoveToPreviousTdInTextObject
methods.description: Moves the enumerator to the previous 'Td' operator within the current text object, or terminates if 'BT' (begin text) is encountered.

nested_classes.name: TextInfo
nested_classes.description: A data structure holding positional, text, and encoding information for a specific text element within a content stream.

methods.name: GetCurrentCoordinates
methods.description: Calculates the current position (X, Y) in the content stream based on 'Td' operators and offsets.

methods.name: GetCurrentOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the X and Y offsets from the content stream, handling the parsing of offset strings and state updates.

methods.name: MoveToPreviousTdInTextObject
methods.description: Navigates backward in the content stream to find the previous 'Td' operator within the current text object.
